svg.title: Terra Mystica setup, in the abstract
svg.desc: A simplified hex map with a river running through it and each player's first two Dwellings on their Home terrain. Below the map: six Scoring tiles for rounds 1 to 6 with the Game end token on round 6, six Power action spaces each covered by an Action token, and Bonus cards equal to the number of players plus three. To the right: the Cult board with four tracks and markers at the bottom, the twelve Favor tile types in a grid, the ten Town tiles, and a Faction board with 12 Power tokens split between Bowls I and II.

g.text: Green hexes: river. Houses: first Dwellings
12 Power in Bowls I and II
